Class ValueSuggestService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.ai.ValueSuggestService
@Service public class ValueSuggestService extends Object
A language model proposes values of a field with the fill source LLM, each with the excerpt of the source that names it. Every run is started by the user. Per security one conversation of at most 3 model rounds, each passing the budget gate, with at most 4 calls of the only tool fetchPage, which reads a public page through UDFFillHttp. The tool calls are executed here, not by the chat model, so that every round is budgeted. A proposal is verified before the user sees it and never written into the values before the user accepts it.

    • enqueuePeriodic

      public void enqueuePeriodic(Integer idTenant)
      Enqueues a value proposal run for every language model field with a fill period whose owner still has a language model of the own tenant. A run decides itself which cells are due, so a field without due cells costs nothing.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - only the fields of users of this home tenant, or null for all tenants

    • runField

      public String runField(Integer idUDFMetadata)
      One run, the work of the task UDF_USER_SUGGEST_VALUES: at most gt.ai.suggest.max.per.run due securities of the tenant scope, see suggestDue(UDFMetadataSecurity, Security, UDFDataFill, String, LocalDate, LocalDateTime). Empty cells come first, in ID order, then the values to refresh, oldest check first. An empty cell gets a proposal the user must accept; a refreshed value replaces the automatic one. When a budget refuses a round, the run stops; the remaining securities stay for the next run.
      Parameters:
      idUDFMetadata - the field
      Returns:
      null, or the message key why the run stopped

    • getSuggestTestCandidates

      public List<UDFSuggestTestCandidate> getSuggestTestCandidates(UDFFillTestRequest request, User user)
      Picks the securities on which the description of a draft field is tested: at most 5 non-private securities of the tenant scope that are still active today, those already holding a value of the field first, each group in ID order. A delisted security has no current figure, so a test on it says nothing about the description. Nothing is sent.
      Parameters:
      request - the draft of the edit form; its fill rule is the description for the model
      user - the caller
      Returns:
      the securities in the order they are tested

    • testSuggestion

      public UDFSuggestTestResult testSuggestion(UDFFillTestRequest request, Integer idSecuritycurrency, User user)
      Tests the description of a draft field on one security: one conversation and the verification of a run, but nothing is stored. The value of the field for this security is withheld from the examples, so the answer can be compared with it. Every model round passes the budgets.
      Parameters:
      request - the draft of the edit form; its fill rule is the description for the model
      idSecuritycurrency - a security of getSuggestTestCandidates(UDFFillTestRequest, User)
      user - the caller
      Returns:
      the outcome of the check with the answer of the model
      Throws:
      DataViolationException - when no provider answered or no provider is configured
      LimitEntityTransactionException - when a budget refuses the next round
